title: Occupational Health and Safety Regulations 2017
why: The specific duties under the OHS Act 2004 whose breach supports a negligence or breach of statutory duty argument: Part 3.1 hazardous manual handling, Part 3.2 noise, Part 3.3 prevention of falls, Part 3.4 confined spaces, Part 3.5 plant, Part 4.1 hazardous substances, Part 4.3 lead, Part 4.4 asbestos, Part 4.5 crystalline silica, Part 5.1 construction; with the general duties of Part 2.1 (risk control, health monitoring).

hand_saved_2026_11_07.original_not_kept_why: as the existing deposits do (the ACT Word files, the Gazette PDF): the converted text and the hashes of the original are kept, not the file

text.converter: vic_convert2.py (stdlib zipfile + ElementTree over word/document.xml; kept outside the repository), the fixed successor of vic_convert.py, which made the first deposit; the notice header is kept as first written

reconverted_2026_11_07.why: vic_convert.py dropped every Word <w:sym> character with a code of F000 or more. The register sets its raised decimal point as Symbol-font character F0D7 (and the multiplication sign, minus sign and bullet as F0B4, F02D, F0B7), so those characters were lost: "1·5 metres" read "15 metres", "19·5%" read "195%", "0·1%" read "01%". vic_convert2.py maps them to Unicode · × − • (and Wingdings boxes to "[ ]").
reconverted_2026_11_07.what_changed: 9 characters restored on 7 lines of the body, all raised decimal points (no ×, − or bullet occurs in this file): r 5 "construction excavation" (a) 1·5 metres; r 5 "safe oxygen level" 19·5%, 19·8 kilopascals, 23·5%, 23·9 kilopascals; r 5 "Schedule 10 carcinogenic substance" (b) and "Schedule 11 carcinogenic substance" (b)(ii) 0·1%; r 178(n) 0·1 square metres; Sch 14 Table 1 item 14 (arsenic trioxide) 0·1 tonnes. Checked by a diff against the first deposit: no other line differs; the notice header and the formula marker 17-22sr018-F1 are unchanged.

text.conversion: The Word file was converted to UTF-8 plain text by Legalese Commons (vic_convert.py: stdlib zipfile and ElementTree over word/document.xml). The table of provisions, running heads and footers are dropped; the cover is kept as the file prints it (twice). Each provision starts on its own line with its number; paragraphs are indented two spaces a level; the register's marginal history notes are kept as "[Side note: ...]" lines before the provision they annotate; tables are "| a | b |" rows; Word equations are linearised in place; each embedded equation object or image is marked "[formula ...]" or "[image ...]" and transcribed in occupational-health-and-safety-regulations-2017.formulas.md. The endnotes (amendment history) are kept. Nothing else is changed.
known_conversion_artefacts: the cover (version number, title, number, version date) appears twice at the head, as in the Word file
the "Note" and "Example" labels stand on their own line, unindented, before their text
multi-line formulas set as indented paragraphs keep their brackets but lose their alignment
